function.arguments: {"observation": "`patient_id` has 48 duplicate values — rows may not be one-per-entity", "implication": "The `patient_id` is not unique per row. Some patients appear more than once, specifically in different `sample_seq` runs. The data dictionary states: 'A patient who was re-tested appears twice. The row with the highest `sample_seq` supersedes earlier rows for that patient.' Therefore, to compute the mean across all patients, we must deduplicate on `patient_id`, keeping only the row with the highest `sample_seq` per patient. Otherwise, we would double-count re-tested patients, biasing the mean."}
function.name: note_finding
